STATEMENT OF DISAGREEMENT
Date: 03/23/2026
Patient's Name: Hernandez Nicolas

I understand that Antelope Valley Medical Center denied my request to change my protected health information. My request was dated 03/06/2026.

[X] I do not want to file a 'Statement of Disagreement,' but I want Antelope Valley Medical Center to include my amendment (change) request and the denial along with all future disclosures of the information subject to my amendment request.
